name: How do I choose the right contractor for a luxury pool project?
description: Choose a contractor with extensive experience in luxury pools, a strong portfolio, verified licenses and insurance, and a clear communication process.

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a luxury pool project?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting a luxury pool contractor, prioritize experience with high-end, custom projects, a strong portfolio of completed work, and excellent client references. Verify their licensing and insurance to ensure compliance and protection. Look for a contractor who offers comprehensive design-build services, has a clear communication process, and understands local building codes and regulations in areas like Pasadena or San Marino. A good contractor will provide transparent pricing and a detailed contract.
